messages.content: read README.md and summarize what helm is

Step 'Inspect environment & tools' completed by ResearchWorker: Helm is an open-source package manager for Kubernetes that simplifies the deployment and management of applications on Kubernetes clusters. It provides a declarative way to define, install, upgrade, and manage complex applications using YAML files known as charts. Helm uses a client-server architecture where the Helm client interacts with the Helm server (Tiller) to manage releases. With Helm, users can easily package and distribute applications, ensuring consistency across different environments.
